long_description:
# v0.6.12

## Features
- Tauri native auto-update system
- Bell icon notification for available updates
- Update changelog modal on startup
- Check for update button in Settings
- Notification toggles (auto-check + show modal)
- Custom multi-size app icons (16x16 to 256x256)

## Technical
- Added tauri-plugin-updater
- GitHub Pages hosted latest.json for update checks
